Class CashierPanel

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
GUI.CashierPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
public class CashierPanel extends JPanel
Cashier screen: a grid of drink buttons plus a pop-up overlay for choosing size, sugar level, ice level and one topping, with a live price total. The drinks come from the menu_items table, so new menu items show up automatically. Finished drinks are added to a cart in the right sidebar; at checkout the cart is saved to the drink_orders table as one order and then cleared.
Author:
Dylan

      items - the menu items to show, in display order

    • loadMenu

      private void loadMenu()
      Loads every drink from the menu_items table (id, name and price) and shows it in the grid. Keeps the current menu if the database can't be reached. Any SQLException is caught and reported to the console, so none is thrown.

    • loadUnavailableMenuIds

      private static Set<Integer> loadUnavailableMenuIds(Connection conn)
      Finds the menu items that can't be made, meaning at least one of their ingredients has less in stock than a Small needs (with no sugar, ice or topping). If the stock check itself fails, no drink is marked unavailable.
      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection
      Returns:
      the menu_item_ids that are out of stock

    • addToCart

      private void addToCart()
      Adds the drink currently configured in the pop-up to the cart, then closes the pop-up.

      private void removeFromCart(int index)
      Removes one drink from the cart, e.g. when the cashier added the wrong one.
      Parameters:

    • updateCartLabels

      private void updateCartLabels()
      Refreshes the cart's drink count and total labels.

    • checkout

      private void checkout()
      Asks the cashier to confirm payment; once paid, saves the cart to the database as one order and empties the cart. If saving fails the cart is kept so the cashier can try again. Save failures (including CashierPanel.OutOfStockException) are caught here and shown in a dialog, so none is thrown.

    • saveOrder

      private int saveOrder() throws SQLException
      Saves everything in the cart to drink_orders as a single order, in one transaction so either every drink is saved or none are.
      Returns:
      the new order's Order-ID
      Throws:
      CashierPanel.OutOfStockException - if an ingredient doesn't have enough left (nothing is saved)
      SQLException - if the connection or any insert fails

    • insertOrder

      static int insertOrder(Connection conn, List<CashierPanel.CartItem> items) throws SQLException
      Inserts the given drinks into drink_orders under the next free Order-ID, using the same formats as the existing order history. Does not commit.
      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection with auto-commit turned off
      items - the drinks in the order
      Returns:
      the Order-ID the drinks were saved under
      Throws:
      SQLException - if any query fails

    • subtractInventory

      static void subtractInventory(Connection conn, List<CashierPanel.CartItem> items) throws SQLException
      Checks that the whole order is in stock and subtracts its ingredients from the inventory table. menu_item_ingredients lists the amounts for a Small, so each drink's amounts are multiplied by 1 (Small), 2 (Medium) or 3 (Large), and a topping adds one unit of its own inventory ingredient. Sugar and ice are subtracted too (SUGAR_AMOUNTS and ICE_AMOUNTS for a Small, scaled by size). Nothing is subtracted if any ingredient is short. Does not commit.
      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection with auto-commit turned off
      items - the drinks in the order
      Throws:
      CashierPanel.OutOfStockException - if an ingredient doesn't have enough left
      SQLException - if any query fails

    • findInventoryId

      private static Integer findInventoryId(Connection conn, String name) throws SQLException
      Looks up an ingredient's id in the inventory table by name (ignoring case).
      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection
      name - the ingredient name, e.g. "Sugar"
      Returns:
      the ingredient_id, or null if inventory has no such row (it is then skipped, unless BLOCK_ON_MISSING_INVENTORY is on)
      Throws:
      CashierPanel.OutOfStockException - if the row is missing and BLOCK_ON_MISSING_INVENTORY is on
      SQLException - if the query fails
